title: Do warm-core eddies hold more or less chlorophyll than cold-core eddies
query: Studies have reported both higher and lower chlorophyll in warm-core (anticyclonic) eddies than in cold-core (cyclonic) eddies. Using the supplied GLORYS12 monthly temperature, salinity, velocity, sea surface height and mixed-layer thickness and CMEMS biogeochemical reanalysis monthly chlorophyll and nitrate for 2011-2020 in the western Tasman Sea off south-eastern Australia (46-26 S, 147-162 E), determine which holds in this region, how the answer depends on season, depth and the way eddies are identified, and why estimates differ. The two products come from different model systems; account for that.

region.name: Tasman Sea and East Australian Current
